topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: Well, would you look at that! The good Lord works in mysterious ways, they say. Just last night, I was tellin' my wife about this far-off friend I've known through the queer contraptions we call computers—never thought we'd share more'n a town's breadth between us. And now, here it is, the heavens sent a sign, and this friend—it turns out they're right here, breathin' the same air as us, walkin' the same paths. I reckon we'll meet, share a drink, and laugh about the world's small places. It's a blessed thing, to find kinship in the most unexpected corners. May the saints keep watch over us all.
